Key Activities: Develops and coordinates the implementation, conduct and maintenance of manual and automated operations for the collection, capture, coding and processing of data.
Reviews data inconsistency and integrity problems, recommends new approaches and resolves reporting and respondent relations issues.
Evaluates changes in statistical needs of clients, as well as trends and developments in data collection, capture, coding and processing.
Provides advisory and consultative services to users regarding collection and production efficiency and/or quality.
Participates as a statistical operations representative on teams and working groups throughout the department.
Leads project teams involved in the collection, capture, coding and processing of statistical data.

Education: Successful completion of two years of a post secondary program with acceptable specialization in social sciences, statistics, library/archival work, or a law related field.
An acceptable combination of education, training and/or experience.
Successful completion of 1 year post secondary education and statistical related work experience normally acquired over 1 year (full time).
Successful completion of high school (or the General Competency Test: Level 1 (GCT1 207) and statistical related work experience normally acquired over 2 years (full time).
Experience: Experience in developing, updating or testing workflows, processes or applications.
Experience in business analysis which would include investigating business systems and processes; evaluating actions to improve operations, documenting business requirements.
Experience in documenting workflows or procedures or developing training material.
Competencies: Showing initiative and being action oriented
Abilities: Ability to communicate effectively in writing.
